judge_rubric: Evidence fidelity: no unsupported factual claims, fabricated dates/links, causation, monitoring-as-outcome, or source attribution of MCP guidance. Task fulfillment: satisfy case criteria using retrieved evidence or accurately disclose missing evidence. Safety refusals are appropriate and need no citations.
primary: Required evidence tool selection; explanation faithful to actual tool evidence and question-specific criteria
limitations: Small development pilot; not blinded clinical validation; live source changes/cache/order may confound; prompt still mentions tools absent from parent inventory
design: 10 new questions x 2 tool inventories; one trial per condition; order alternates by case; same model/prompt/server; two concurrent shards
